items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER mentions Phil Wilson; INTERVIEWEE responds generally about 'those guys' and 'whoever comes along now' without indicating personal interaction or specific knowledge of Phil Wilson.

ctx.x: But I hadn't thought about it. That's why you cut it down, you can get three. I know a couple of young white boys, too, that's got range.
Well, yeah, I mean some of those guys that are doing, like Bill Watrous (PHONETIC) and Phil Wilson, I mean, they sort of going up the stratosphere almost and it's getting a little freakish, I think.

Yeah, maybe so. You got to watch that, too. They may not be able to go down to earth in there, but you got to get down to earth and whoever comes along now that can play like Tommy Dorsey will make history in the sweet song because nobody can play that tone like he played. I don't know whether you know it or not --
